name: eqvps
title: EQVPS
description: Crypto-paid, no-KYC VPS hosting that AI agents can rent and operate end-to-end over MCP: discover plans, create an account, top up with USDC/USDT, order a VPS, then control it (power, hostname, reinstall, metrics).

authentication.description: AI AGENTS (this MCP): call the register_account tool — the agent supplies its own credentials and receives a Bearer token immediately (no email, no OTP code, no human step). Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Do NOT use the website email-OTP flow; that path is for humans in a browser only and an agent cannot complete it (cannot read email). Catalog tools (list_plans) are public.
authentication.tokenAcquisition: tool:register_account (agents get a Bearer token instantly — NOT the human email-OTP flow)
authentication.x-agentAuth: register_account tool -> Bearer token, immediate, no email/OTP/human step
authentication.x-humanAuth: website eqvps.com only: passwordless email OTP code, not usable by agents

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List available VPS plans with pricing, specs and OS images.

tools.name: register_account
tools.description: Create an EQVPS account (no human/KYC step). Returns a Bearer token.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in with email + password; returns a Bearer token.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Return prepaid credit balance and currency.

tools.name: topup_balance
tools.description: Create a crypto top-up invoice; returns a PayRam checkout URL.

tools.name: order_vps
tools.description: Order a VPS by plan slug + OS id (pays from prepaid balance).

tools.name: pay_invoice
tools.description: Initiate crypto payment for an owned unpaid invoice; returns checkout URL.

tools.name: list_vps
tools.description: List the account's VPS services (id, status, plan).

tools.name: get_vps_status
tools.description: Full detail for one VPS: status, specs, live VM state/uptime, SSH access.

tools.name: power_vps
tools.description: Power-control a VPS: start, stop or reboot.

tools.name: set_hostname
tools.description: Set the VPS hostname (DNS label; applied on reboot/rebuild).

tools.name: reinstall_vps
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: wipe and reinstall the VPS with a given OS image.

tools.name: get_vps_metrics
tools.description: Time-series resource metrics (CPU, memory, network, disk) for a VPS.

x-eqvps.payment: crypto USDC & USDT on Base and Ethereum, via PayRam — no KYC
